req.title: Root endpoint responds
req.statement: The system shall serve a welcome message at GET / with HTTP 200.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET / must return HTTP 200 with a specific JSON payload. To maximise mutation kill rate we: (1) assert the exact status code 200 (catches 201/204/etc mutations), (2) assert every key and value in the response dict exactly (catches string-constant mutations), (3) test that a wrong method (POST /) returns 405 to confirm the route is GET-only (negative path), (4) test that the response Content-Type is application/json (boundary of protocol correctness), and (5) assert the exact number of keys in the payload to catch additions/removals. We also verify the 'version' constant '1.0.0' exactly, the 'docs' path '/docs' exactly, and the 'message' string exactly — each assertion targets a distinct mutation operator.

tests.name: test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
expected: Response JSON has exactly 3 keys: message, docs, version
message equals 'Welcome to Task Manager API'
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert len(body) == 3
    assert body["message"] == "Welcome to Task Manager API"
    assert body["docs"] == "/docs"
    assert body["version"] == "1.0.0"

test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_post_returns_405_method_not_allowed():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.post("/")
    assert r.status_code == 405
    body = r.json()
    assert "message" not in body or body.get("message") != "Welcome to Task Manager API"

tests.name: test_root_response_content_type_is_json
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
expected: Response is parseable as JSON with no extra or missing keys
trace: R-TASK-018: expected payload implies JSON content type; boundary of protocol correctness
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_response_content_type_is_json():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert ct.startswith("application/json")
    body = r.json()
    assert set(body.keys()) == {"message", "docs", "version"}
    assert body["version"] == "1.0.0"
    assert body["docs"] == "/docs"
    assert body["message"] == "Welcome to Task Manager API"

test_root_response_content_type_is_json()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_get_not_found_on_wrong_path():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/nonexistent")
    assert r.status_code == 404
    body = r.json()
    assert body.get("message") != "Welcome to Task Manager API"
